findings.evidence: Customer data transferred to Publisher will be held and maintained by Publisher pursuant to Publishers respective privacy policies, which can be found at the following: http://lima.ohcommedia.com, http://sedalia.ohcommedia.com, http://jacksonville.ohcommedia.com and http://alton.ohcommedia.com.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that IP addresses or device IDs are shared with Google AdMob. It only mentions transferring customer data to publishers, but does not specify the data types or the purpose.
